description: This file defines client-side form logic for the 'POS Opening Entry' doctype in ERPNext, handling setup, refresh, field properties, and related data fetching.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the form, setting default values and query filters when the form is loaded.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the form, setting default posting date and updating read-only status.

methods.name: set_posting_date_read_only
methods.description: Sets the 'posting_date' field to read-only or editable based on current conditions.

methods.name: set_posting_date
methods.description: Triggers the read-only status update for 'posting_date'.

methods.name: pos_profile
methods.description: Event handler when 'pos_profile' field changes, loads related payment modes into 'balance_details'.
